validation.dueDateAfterIssue: The due date must fall after the issue date
validation.amountPositive: The amount must be greater than 0
validation.policyNameMin: The name must be at least 3 characters

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.subtitle: Reminder proposals awaiting review
inbox.rejectConfirmDescription: This sends no message at all and can be undone by generating the proposals again.
inbox.approveConfirmDescription: The messages go into the sending queue and are delivered automatically. Payment demands in the selection are skipped — each needs its own approval.
inbox.empty: No proposals waiting. Everything is up to date.

proposal.emptySelection: Select a proposal from the list to see its content.
proposal.approveDemandDescription: This is a formal debt-collection step for {{client}} ({{invoice}}). Payment demands always require a single, deliberate approval.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Review, issue and import the invoices supervised by the system.
invoices.searchPlaceholder: Search by invoice number or client…
invoices.emptyDescription: No invoice matches the current search criteria.

invoiceForm.title: New invoice
invoiceForm.description: Enter the invoice data. The client is created automatically if it does not exist yet.

import.title: Import invoices
import.description: A CSV or Excel file with the columns: invoice number, client, issue date, due date, amount, seller.
import.conflictsNote: {{n}} conflicting invoice numbers — resolving them arrives in the next iteration.

invoiceDetail.invalidIdMessage: The requested invoice cannot be found.
invoiceDetail.notFoundMessage: The selected invoice could not be loaded.
invoiceDetail.description: Invoice details, payment history and dispute status.
invoiceDetail.paymentsErrorTitle: Could not load the payment history

clients.title: Clients
clients.description: Clients with their current receivables exposure — click a name to see the details.
clients.emptyDescription: Add your first client to start tracking their invoices.

clientDetail.notFoundMessage: The selected client does not exist or could not be loaded.
clientDetail.description: Receivables exposure, escalation and the client's invoice history.
clientDetail.exposureErrorTitle: Could not load the client's exposure
clientDetail.invoicesEmptyDescription: This client has no invoices yet.

escalation.title: Escalate every open invoice of this client
escalation.description: Force all {{n}} open invoices of {{client}} straight to the selected stage, without waiting for the policy's time thresholds.
escalation.confirmDescription: Every open invoice of {{client}} gets a new proposal at this stage in the Inbox. Nothing is sent automatically — it still waits for your approval.

policies.title: Policies
policies.description: Strictness (when and how firmly to remind) and tone (how it sounds) are independent dimensions.
policies.emptyDescription: Create your first policy to define the strictness and tone of the communication.

policyForm.title: New policy
policyForm.restrictivenessLabel: Strictness (how often and how firmly to remind)
policyForm.toneLabel: Tone (how the message sounds) — independent of strictness

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Coverage matrix: every Tone × Channel × Escalation stage combination needs a saved template, otherwise proposal generation is blocked (there is never a fallback to a live AI call).
templates.emptyDescription: Add a communication tone in a policy to see the template matrix.

templateEditor.descriptionExisting: Edit the saved content directly or generate it again with AI. When sending, the system only substitutes variable values — no further AI calls.
templateEditor.descriptionNew: No template saved for this combination. Generate the content with AI (once, right now) and then save it.
templateEditor.deleteDescription: This tone, channel and stage combination will block proposal generation again until you save a new template.

notifications.title: Delivery history
notifications.description: A complete audit log of every message sent (AI-005).
notifications.loadErrorTitle: Could not load the delivery history
notifications.failedHint: Most common cause: the client has no e-mail address or phone number on file. Complete the contact data under Clients, then approve the proposal again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.notice: The schedule only generates proposals for review — it never sends anything automatically (AI-002).
